newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia up sharply amid solid demand.
newsitem.headline: Nokia up sharply amid solid demand.

text.p: Shares in Finnish telecoms group Nokia Oy rose sharply in early Helsinki trade on Wednesday, propelled by solid demand in active dealings after sharp overnight gains in Wall Street tech stocks, brokers said.

At 1130/0930 GMT Nokia was up 11.00 markka or about four percent at 283.00 markka, surpassing the 279 markka equivalent of its New York close. Early dealings volume in Nokia was heavy compared to recent levels, at around 46 percent of total bourse volume of over 100 million markka.
Brokers said there was "basic demand" for all Helsinki stocks as the HEX index again hit new highs.
